variantHints.int8: int8: weights quantized to 8-bit integers. Much smaller and faster than the full-precision original, with a small accuracy tradeoff.
variantHints.fp16: fp16: weights stored in 16-bit floating point. About half the size of the full-precision original with minimal accuracy loss - needs a GPU/runtime that supports fp16.
variantHints.q4: q4: weights quantized to 4-bit integers. Very small file size, but a larger accuracy tradeoff than int8.
variantHints.q4f16: q4f16: 4-bit weights with 16-bit floating-point activations. A middle ground between q4 and fp16 for size vs accuracy.
variantHints.quantized: quantized: weights compressed to reduce file size and speed up inference, at some accuracy cost. The exact bit-width isn't specified in the filename.
variantHints.merged: merged: a HuggingFace Optimum export detail (decoder-with-past merged into one graph) - not a quality or size difference.

optimization.title: Optimization
optimization.idleUnloadHint: Off by default. When on, Echophrase frees the speech model's memory (including GPU memory) after this many minutes without recording, which helps when it sits in the tray while you game. The catch: the next recording has to reload the model, about 7 seconds on a typical GPU (longer on slower machines or the very first time on a new GPU), and it reloads while you talk.
optimization.idleUnloadMinutesAria: Minutes of inactivity before the model is unloaded

gpu.requiresMacos13: Requires macOS 13+ - CPU only on this Mac
gpu.providerAutoReason: Let Echophrase pick the fastest device for you.
gpu.providerCpuReason: Force CPU for potato devices - useful for battery savings or when GPU is busy elsewhere.
gpu.tooltipAuto: Echophrase enumerates all available devices at runtime and picks the fastest one (DirectML > CoreML > NPU > CPU).
gpu.tooltipDirectml: Built into Windows. Works with any GPU (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel).
gpu.tooltipCoreml: Native Apple Silicon acceleration. Best performance on Mac.
gpu.tooltipCpu: WARNING: Not recommended. Very slow transcription speed and reduced accuracy. In all honesty, if you have to use CPU, this app will frustrate you ;)
gpu.metalRequiresMacos13: Metal GPU requires macOS 13 (Ventura) or later. Your Mac uses CPU mode instead.
